basics.name: Riley Okafor
basics.label: Backend Engineer
basics.summary: Backend engineer with eight years on data-heavy services. Most at home in Go and PostgreSQL, and happiest owning a system end to end rather than a slice of one.

bullets.text: Resharded the shipment ledger in PostgreSQL behind a dual-write cutover, taking p99 write latency from 910ms to 120ms with no downtime.
Owned the Kafka ingestion pipeline carrying 60 million carrier events per day, including the consumer rebalancing work that ended a year of duplicate deliveries.
Mentored five engineers through their first on-call rotations; two were promoted to senior within the following year.
Ran the schema review that product teams bring changes to before shipping, which cut emergency migrations from roughly one a month to two in a year.
Rewrote the rating service from Python to Go, cutting median response time 4x and halving its memory footprint.
Won the internal hackathon with a browser extension that surfaced shipment status in Gmail.
Built the nightly ETL that consolidated seven client databases into one warehouse, in Go, running unattended for three years.
Set up streaming replication and point-in-time recovery for the primary PostgreSQL cluster after a near-miss data loss incident.
Organised the office coffee rota and ran the summer intern social programme.
